# Sample dossier

This is a **fictional** company used to preview the design. Real brochures show Claude's full research dossier here, with source links next to each fact.

profile.one_liner: A fictional UK freight forwarder moving palletised goods for retailers and manufacturers.

signals.detail: Opened a second cross-dock hub this year, adding volume without adding a planning team.
Four open customer-service roles suggest inbound tracking queries are outpacing the team.
Won a three-year contract with a national homeware retailer.
Runs a legacy TMS with heavy spreadsheet use for quoting.

profile.ai_maturity_reason: Staff mention ChatGPT on LinkedIn, but no governed AI tools or policy are visible.
talking_points: Congratulate them on the new retail contract and ask how onboarding is going.
Ask how many 'where's my delivery' queries the team handles a day.
Ask whether there is an AI policy yet; offer the free policy creator.

cover.intro: You've added a new hub and a major retail contract. We help your team absorb that growth with [[governed AI]] that handles the repetitive work, so your people stay focused on customers.

snapshot.title: Where Northwind is today
snapshot.intro: Northwind is growing quickly: a second cross-dock hub, a three-year homeware contract and **four open customer-service roles**. Growth like this usually lands first on the people answering tracking queries and building quotes.
snapshot.callout: The opportunity: absorb new volume **without** growing the back office at the same rate.
snapshot.dark_text: Your team is already experimenting with AI tools. Getting it [[governed and pointed at the right workflow]] now means the new contract runs smoothly, and your customer data stays protected.

insights.title: Growth outpacing the team
insights.body: Open service roles and a new hub suggest inbound queries are rising faster than headcount.

insights.title: Quoting runs on spreadsheets
insights.body: Manual rate lookups slow quotes and make margins harder to see.

insights.title: A new anchor customer
insights.body: Retail contracts bring strict SLAs and reporting expectations from day one.

insights.title: AI use without guardrails
insights.body: Staff are trying AI tools, but there's no visible policy covering customer data.

opportunities.title: Where AI can pay back for Northwind
opportunities.intro: Six opportunities, ranked by value against effort. The first three are typical 30-day builds.

items.title: Tracking query agent
items.body: Answers 'where's my delivery' emails from TMS data, with a person checking exceptions.

items.title: Faster freight quotes
items.body: Drafts quotes from rate cards and lane history for a planner to approve.

items.title: POD and paperwork processing
items.body: Reads delivery notes and PODs, flags discrepancies, updates records.

items.title: Automated SLA reporting
items.body: Builds weekly customer performance packs from your systems.

items.title: Load and route suggestions
items.body: Suggests consolidations across hubs for planners to accept or adjust.

items.title: Driver and staff knowledge base
items.body: Instant answers on procedures, site rules and compliance, from your own documents.

opportunities.highlight_title: Our suggested first build: the tracking query agent
opportunities.highlight_body: It sits on data you already have, takes pressure off the team you're recruiting for, and gives a [[measurable result in 30 days]].

path.title: Your path with True Worth AI
path.intro: Start small, prove the value, then scale on proof.
path.recommended_reason: With a new hub and a new contract, a two-week Roadmap pins down which workflow pays back fastest before you commit to a build.

steps.label: WEEKS 1–2 · AI ROADMAP
steps.title: Find the payback
steps.body: We map quoting, tracking and paperwork with your ops leads and rank the opportunities.

steps.label: WEEKS 3–6 · 30-DAY PROJECT
steps.title: Build the first agent
steps.body: We build the top opportunity inside your systems, governed and live in 30 days.

steps.label: DAY 90 · PROOF
steps.title: Measure the return
steps.body: We track the result against the baseline agreed in week one.

steps.label: ONGOING · SUPPORT
steps.title: Scale on proof
steps.body: We keep it running and build the next opportunity on your plan.

proof.title: Proof from businesses like yours
proof.intro: Our customer-service work maps closely to your tracking queries.

close.lead_note: John will run your Roadmap himself and write the plan your team acts on.
